profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | CyberSecurity Analyst | Technical Project Manager | Scrum Master
profile.summary:
Results-driven Technical Project Manager | Product Manager | Senior Software Engineer

I bring 10+ years of experience leading cross-functional software teams, delivering complex applications/features, and bridging the gap between business strategy and engineering solutions.

As a Senior Software Engineer and Scrum Master, I’ve directed sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog grooming/prioritization ceremonies; coordinated distributed teams across time zones; and partnered with product, design, and DevOps to deliver high-impact features.

My technical background means I “speak developer,” while my leadership experience ensures projects stay aligned with business goals.

Now, I’m excited to bring my mix of technical expertise, project leadership, and product mindset to a Technical Project Management or Product Management role where I can help organizations deliver value faster and more effectively.

💬 Let’s connect if you’re looking for a TPM/PM who can drive results, reduce delivery risk, and build bridges between stakeholders and engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer III / Lead
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Responsible for development and maintenance of complex React components retrieving, manipulating, and posting large data sets for the Internal Tools Application.
- Developed and maintained custom React hooks for processing, requesting, and submitting data via graphQL, as well as managing state using Apollo’s caching features.
- Lead on multiple journey teams facilitating communication with stakeholders and other developers from various micro-service and SalesForce teams guiding each project from product request and design to tech scoping, on to ticketing, planning, development, and ultimately all the way through to delivery and support beyond.
- Directed Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives), ensuring consistent delivery across a distributed engineering team.
- Acted as a mentor for new hires to ramp them up, as the team expanded, into high performing individual contributors sprint over sprint
- Responsibilities included monitoring reported application bugs from users via Slack. Then debugging included working with New Relic, Kubernetes, and potentially other teams to fix any outage or user/feature related issues.
- Ownership of initiative to migrate components from proprietary shared component library to using Material UI and support a more dynamic set of options for included components
- Ownership of ongoing migration from React HOCs to custom hooks improving application architecture and standards
- Coordinated the improvement of team retrospectives, grooming, and ticket writing to generated more value from the team’s day to day contributions; leading to more performant and efficient sprints

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Tech Lead
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Responsible for end to end development of various features including a new authentication flow, introducing an e-commerce platform, and vehicle appraisal flow
- Partnered with product managers, designers, and DevOps to translate business requirements into actionable technical plans.
- Introduced Jest unit testing to the project and set up the team to run with unit testing
- Led cross-team initiatives, aligning roadmaps and priorities with stakeholder expectations.
- Tech lead for Appraisal feature team spanning several time zones (sprint planning, sizing/assigning Jira tickets, reviewing pull requests, and leading production releases nearly daily)
- Improved delivery efficiency via process changes that reduced release cycle time.
- Organization, planning, and executing migration of our FE code from React/Redux over to Next/MobX
- Improved efficiency of the Appraisal product in preparation for high profile NFL ad help allow for the feature to handle the influx of traffic at game time.
- Onboarding new developers and mentoring junior developers
- Setting and monitoring events in Datadog
- Maintaining styles using css processors (SASS, postcss) and REACT
Styled Components

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York to Pasadena, California
positions.description:
- Responsible for creating features and dynamic reusable components in both Angular and React 
- Improved state management and standards with Redux to be used with the proprietary framework
- Worked to convert components from angular to react as well as from react to the proprietary framework 
- Acted as Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies and ensuring blockers were resolved quickly across a distributed engineering team.
- Communicating the needs of the team to both leadership and development partners
- Worked closely with API team and server architects to ensure data was organized and efficient for consumption client side
- Contributed to introducing Unit Tests and consistently keeping them updated/passing and above 90% code coverage
- Making sure the application was responsive, then later switched to adaptive for appropriate circumstances
- Architecting data models to be used across the application’s Time products

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Lead front end engineer for medpagetoday.com
Front End Engineer Lead on MedpageToday.com
Worked to make the article pages for MedpageToday responsive for desktop and all devices in both portait and landscape modes.
Created templates for responsive html emails
Extensive login logic using Prototyping, jQuery, and AJAX to display the correct login interstitials when necessary depending on user settings, article views, and url parameters
Extensive work with Cold Fusion and PHP pages
Trained and used in-house CMS

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Extensive Front End Development work centering around creating elaborately designed web sites using CSS 3.0, HTML5, JQuery, and AJAX
Spent a sizable amount of time developing using Adobe's Day CQ CMS environments
Also spent time developing within Microsoft Visual Studio 2010
Experienced creating Front End code that works together with various backend envirnments such as ASP.NET, JAVA, and PHP
Managed updates for multiple sites using wordpress
Created Facebook tabs and applications using both iframes and FBML
Coded and deployed HTML emails via SMTP and exacttarget.com

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Publishing and deploying pre-generated solicitation pages using company created tools and programs
Creating templates for solicitation pages, including validation, HTML, CSS, and various Javascript functions
Fixing problems within existing templates through CSS
Putting together documentation of day to day processes
Creating and editing project specs
Creating and managing SQL tables in the database

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Resized images from clients using Photoshop in order to better utilize the database.
Maintained templates and used templates to create pages for clients in Dreamweaver
Handled client webpage issues involving pictures and text borders
